headlines.title: GPT-6 Astra Users Say OpenAI's Newest Model Got Dumber. It Happened Before, Too
headlines.description: A week after launch, complaints are rolling in from users that GPT-6 Astra has been nerfed. OpenAI's last model went through the same cycle in July.
headlines.summary: Users say OpenAI’s new GPT-6 Astra feels weaker shortly after launch, echoing past complaints.
headlines.why_it_matters: Underscores need to monitor post-launch model changes and design around shifting behavior or safety tuning.
